// Utility types
type RevalidateRange<T> = T extends { revalidate: any } ? NonNegative<T['revalidate']> : never

// If T is unknown or any, it will be an empty {} type. Otherwise, it will be the same as Omit<T, keyof Base>.
type OmitWithTag<T, K extends keyof any, _M> = Omit<T, K>
type Diff<Base, T extends Base, Message extends string = ''> = 0 extends (1 & T) ? {} : OmitWithTag<T, keyof Base, Message>

type FirstArg<T extends Function> = T extends (...args: [infer T, any]) => any ? unknown extends T ? any : T : never
type SecondArg<T extends Function> = T extends (...args: [any, infer T]) => any ? unknown extends T ? any : T : never
type MaybeField<T, K extends string> = T extends { [k in K]: infer G } ? G extends Function ? G : never : never

type ParamCheck<T> = {
  __tag__: string
  __param_position__: string
  __param_type__: T
}

function checkFields<_ extends { [k in keyof any]: never }>() {}

// https://github.com/sindresorhus/type-fest
type Numeric = number | bigint
type Zero = 0 | 0n
type Negative<T extends Numeric> = T extends Zero ? never : `${T}` extends `-${string}` ? T : never
type NonNegative<T extends Numeric> = T extends Zero ? T : Negative<T> extends never ? T : '__invalid_negative_number__'

    /**
     * Cache this `"use cache"` for a timespan defined by the `"default"` profile.
     * ```
     *   stale:      300 seconds (5 minutes)
     *   revalidate: 900 seconds (15 minutes)
     *   expire:     never
     * ```
     * 
     * This cache may be stale on clients for 5 minutes before checking with the server.
     * If the server receives a new request after 15 minutes, start revalidating new values in the background.
     * It lives for the maximum age of the server cache. If this entry has no traffic for a while, it may serve an old value the next request.
     */
    export function unstable_cacheLife(profile: "default"): void

    export function unstable_cacheLife(profile: "seconds"): void

===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\hooks\useConverter.ts =====

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ApiClientError } from "@/lib/services/api-client-utils";
import { convertMedia } from "@/lib/services/conversion-client";
import { buildOutputFilename } from "@/lib/utils/format";
import type { ConversionStatus, ConvertedFile } from "@/types/api";
import type { OutputType } from "@/types/media";

export interface UseConverterReturn {
  status: ConversionStatus;
  result: ConvertedFile | null;
  error: string | null;
  isProcessing: boolean;
  convert: (file: File, dimension: number, outputType: OutputType) => Promise<void>;
  reset: () => void;
  dismissError: () => void;
}

export function useConverter(): UseConverterReturn {
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<ConversionStatus>("idle");
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ConvertedFile | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const urlRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const revokeUrl = useCallback(() => {
    if (urlRef.current) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
      urlRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => revokeUrl, [revokeUrl]);

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    if (busyRef.current) {
      return;
    }
    revokeUrl();
    setResult(null);
    setError(null);
    setStatus("idle");
  }, [revokeUrl]);

  const dismissError = useCallback(() => setError(null), []);

  const convert = useCallback(
    async (file: File, dimension: number, outputType: OutputType): Promise<void> => {
      if (busyRef.current) {
        return;
      }

      busyRef.current = true;
      revokeUrl();
      setResult(null);
      setError(null);
      setStatus("processing");

      try {
        const output = await convertMedia(file, dimension, outputType);
        const url = URL.createObjectURL(output.blob);
        urlRef.current = url;

        setResult({
          ...output,
          url,
          filename: buildOutputFilename(file.name, outputType, dimension, output.extension),
        });
        setStatus("success");
      } catch (caught) {
        const message =
          caught instanceof ApiClientError
            ? caught.message
            : "DÃ¶nÃ¼ÅŸtÃ¼rme sÄ±rasÄ±nda bir sorun oluÅŸtu. LÃ¼tfen tekrar deneyin.";
        setError(message);
        setStatus("error");
      } finally {
        busyRef.current = false;
      }
    },
    [revokeUrl],
  );

  return {
    status,
    result,
    error,
    isProcessing: status === "processing",
    convert,
    reset,
    dismissError,
  };
}

"use client";

import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { getMediaKindFromFile } from "@/lib/utils/media";
import { validateFileMeta } from "@/lib/utils/validation";
import type { MediaKind } from "@/types/media";

export interface UseImageUploadReturn {
  file: File | null;
  mediaKind: MediaKind | null;
  previewUrl: string | null;
  error: string | null;
  selectFile: (candidate: File | null | undefined) => boolean;
  clearFile: () => void;
  dismissError: () => void;
}

export function useImageUpload(): UseImageUploadReturn {
  const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [previewUrl, setPreviewUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const urlRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const revokeUrl = useCallback(() => {
    if (urlRef.current) {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(urlRef.current);
      urlRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => revokeUrl, [revokeUrl]);

  const mediaKind = useMemo<MediaKind | null>(
    () => (file ? getMediaKindFromFile(file) : null),
    [file],
  );

  const selectFile = useCallback(
    (candidate: File | null | undefined): boolean => {
      if (!candidate) {
        return false;
      }

      const validation = validateFileMeta({
        name: candidate.name,
        type: candidate.type,
        size: candidate.size,
      });

      if (!validation.ok) {
        setError(validation.message);
        return false;
      }

      revokeUrl();
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(candidate);
      urlRef.current = url;
      setFile(candidate);
      setPreviewUrl(url);
      setError(null);
      return true;
    },
    [revokeUrl],
  );

  const clearFile = useCallback(() => {
    revokeUrl();
    setFile(null);
    setPreviewUrl(null);
    setError(null);
  }, [revokeUrl]);

  const dismissError = useCallback(() => setError(null), []);

  return { file, mediaKind, previewUrl, error, selectFile, clearFile, dismissError };
}

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ApiClientError } from "@/lib/services/api-client-utils";
import { fetchMediaFromUrl } from "@/lib/services/import-client";
import { parseImportUrl } from "@/lib/utils/url-validation";

export interface UseUrlImportReturn {
  isLoading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  importUrl: (rawUrl: string) => Promise<File | null>;
  clearError: () => void;
}

export function useUrlImport(): UseUrlImportReturn {
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);

      return null;

      setError(validation.message);
      return null;

    setIsLoading(true);

      return await fetchMediaFromUrl(validation.url.href);

      );
      return null;
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  const clearError = useCallback(() => setError(null), []);

  return { isLoading, error, importUrl, clearError };
}



===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\lib\services\media\processors\ffmpeg-processor.ts =====

import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import { join } from "node:path";
import {
  ANIMATED_ENCODE_ATTEMPTS,
  ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_BYTES,
  ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_SECONDS,
  FFMPEG_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  FFMPEG_MAX_CONCURRENT,
  FFMPEG_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS,
} from "@/lib/constants";
import { AppError } from "@/lib/utils/errors";
import { getMediaInfo, isMediaMimeType } from "@/lib/utils/media";
import type {
  ConversionOptions,
  ConversionResult,
  MediaInput,
  MediaProcessor,
} from "@/types/media";
import { getFfmpegPath, probeMedia, runFfmpeg } from "../ffmpeg";

const VIDEO_MIME_TYPES: readonly string[] = ["video/mp4", "video/webm"];
const BASE_ARGS: readonly string[] = ["-hide_banner", "-loglevel", "error", "-y"];

let activeJobs = 0;

function corruptError(): AppError {
  return new AppError("CORRUPT_IMAGE", "Bu medya okunamadÄ±. Dosya bozuk olabilir.", 422);
}

function timeoutError(): AppError {
  return new AppError("CONVERSION_FAILED", "DÃ¶nÃ¼ÅŸtÃ¼rme Ã§ok uzun sÃ¼rdÃ¼.", 504);
}

function buildAnimatedArgs(
  inputPath: string,
  outputPath: string,
  dimension: number,
  fps: number,
  quality: number,
): string[] {
  const filter = [
    `fps=${fps}`,
    "format=rgba",
    `scale=${dimension}:${dimension}:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease:flags=lanczos`,
    `pad=${dimension}:${dimension}:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=black@0`,
  ].join(",");

  return [
    ...BASE_ARGS,
    "-t", String(ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_SECONDS),
    "-i", inputPath,
    "-an",
    "-vf", filter,
    "-c:v", "libwebp_anim",
    "-lossless", "0",
    "-quality", String(quality),
    "-compression_level", "4",
    "-loop", "0",
    outputPath,
  ];
}

export class FfmpegProcessor implements MediaProcessor {
  readonly id = "ffmpeg";
  private readonly stillProcessor: MediaProcessor;

  constructor(stillProcessor: MediaProcessor) {
    this.stillProcessor = stillProcessor;
  }

  supports(input: MediaInput, options: ConversionOptions): boolean {
    if (getFfmpegPath() === null) return false;
    if (VIDEO_MIME_TYPES.includes(input.mimeType)) return true;
    return input.mimeType === "image/gif";
  }

  async process(input: MediaInput, options: ConversionOptions): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    const binary = getFfmpegPath();
    if (binary === null || !isMediaMimeType(input.mimeType)) {
      throw new AppError("UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA", "Sunucuda FFmpeg bulunamadÄ±.");
    }

    if (activeJobs >= FFMPEG_MAX_CONCURRENT) {
      throw new AppError("SERVER_ERROR", "Sunucu ÅŸu anda yoÄŸun. Tekrar deneyin.", 503);
    }

    activeJobs += 1;
    const workDir = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), "wsc-"));

    try {
      const inputPath = join(workDir, `input.${getMediaInfo(input.mimeType).extension}`);
      await writeFile(inputPath, input.buffer);

      const probe = await probeMedia(binary, inputPath, FFMPEG_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS);
      if (!probe.hasVideo) {
        throw new AppError("CORRUPT_IMAGE", "Okunabilir bir medya akÄ±ÅŸÄ± bulunamadÄ±.", 422);
      }

      if (options.outputType === "sticker" || options.outputType === "animation") {
        return await this.encodeAnimatedSticker(binary, inputPath, workDir, options, probe.durationSeconds);
      }

      return await this.extractFirstFrame(binary, inputPath, workDir, input, options);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof AppError) throw error;
      console.error("FFmpeg hatasÄ±:", error);
      throw new AppError("CONVERSION_FAILED", "Medya dÃ¶nÃ¼ÅŸtÃ¼rÃ¼lemedi.", 500);
    } finally {
      activeJobs -= 1;
      await rm(workDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  }

  private async encodeAnimatedSticker(
    binary: string,
    inputPath: string,
    workDir: string,
    options: ConversionOptions,
    durationSeconds: number | null,
  ): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    const outputPath = join(workDir, "output.webp");
    const startedAt = Date.now();
    let best: Buffer | null = null;

    for (const attempt of ANIMATED_ENCODE_ATTEMPTS) {
      const remaining = FFMPEG_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS - (Date.now() - startedAt);
      if (remaining <= 0) break;

      const run = await runFfmpeg(
        binary,
        buildAnimatedArgs(inputPath, outputPath, options.dimension, attempt.fps, attempt.quality),
        Math.min(FFMPEG_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS, remaining),
      );

      if (run.timedOut) {
        if (best === null) throw timeoutError();
        break;
      }
      if (run.exitCode !== 0) throw corruptError();

      best = await readFile(outputPath);
      if (best.length <= ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_BYTES) break;
    }

    if (best === null) throw timeoutError();

    const warnings: string[] = [];
    if (durationSeconds !== null && durationSeconds > ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_SECONDS) {
      warnings.push(`Medya ${ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_SECONDS} saniyeye kÄ±saltÄ±ldÄ±.`);
    }
    if (best.length > ANIMATED_STICKER_MAX_BYTES) {
      warnings.push("Bu Ã§Ä±kartma 500 KB'den bÃ¼yÃ¼k. WhatsApp reddedebilir.");
    }

    return {
      buffer: best,
      mimeType: "image/webp",
      extension: "webp",
      width: options.dimension,
      height: options.dimension,
      sizeBytes: best.length,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  private async extractFirstFrame(
    binary: string,
    inputPath: string,
    workDir: string,
    input: MediaInput,
    options: ConversionOptions,
  ): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    const framePath = join(workDir, "frame.png");

    const run = await runFfmpeg(
      binary,
      [...BASE_ARGS, "-i", inputPath, "-frames:v", "1", framePath],
      FFMPEG_ATTEMPT_TIMEOUT_MS,
    );

    if (run.timedOut) throw timeoutError();
    if (run.exitCode !== 0) throw corruptError();

    const frame = await readFile(framePath);
    const result = await this.stillProcessor.process(
      { buffer: frame, mimeType: "image/png", filename: input.filename },
      options,
    );

    return {
      ...result,
      warnings: ["Videonun yalnÄ±zca ilk karesi kullanÄ±ldÄ±.", ...result.warnings],
    };
  }
}


===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\lib\services\media\processors\image-processor.ts =====

import sharp from "sharp";
import {
  PROCESSABLE_MIME_TYPES,
  STICKER_MAX_BYTES,
  STICKER_QUALITY_STEPS,
} from "@/lib/constants";
import { AppError } from "@/lib/utils/errors";
import type {
  ConversionOptions,
  ConversionResult,
  MediaInput,
  MediaProcessor,
} from "@/types/media";

const TRANSPARENT = { r: 0, g: 0, b: 0, alpha: 0 } as const;
const ANIMATED_GIF_WARNING = "Animasyonlu GIF'in yalnÄ±zca ilk karesi kullanÄ±ldÄ±.";

interface RenderedFrame {
  readonly data: Buffer;
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
}

export class ImageProcessor implements MediaProcessor {
  readonly id = "image";

  supports(input: MediaInput): boolean {
    return (PROCESSABLE_MIME_TYPES as readonly string[]).includes(input.mimeType);
  }

  async process(input: MediaInput, options: ConversionOptions): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    try {
      const inputWarnings = await this.collectInputWarnings(input);
      const frame = await this.renderFrame(input.buffer, options.dimension);

      const result =
        options.outputType === "sticker" || options.outputType === "animation"
          ? await this.encodeSticker(frame)
          : await this.encodePng(frame);

      return { ...result, warnings: [...inputWarnings, ...result.warnings] };
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof AppError) throw error;
      if (
        error instanceof Error &&
        /unsupported image format|corrupt|truncated|bad seek|invalid|vips/i.test(error.message)
      ) {
        throw new AppError("CORRUPT_IMAGE", "Bu gÃ¶rsel okunamadÄ±.", 422);
      }
      console.error("GÃ¶rsel hatasÄ±:", error);
      throw new AppError("CONVERSION_FAILED", "GÃ¶rsel dÃ¶nÃ¼ÅŸtÃ¼rÃ¼lemedi.", 500);
    }
  }

  private async collectInputWarnings(input: MediaInput): Promise<string[]> {
    if (input.mimeType !== "image/gif") return [];
    const metadata = await sharp(input.buffer, { failOn: "error" }).metadata();
    return (metadata.pages ?? 1) > 1 ? [ANIMATED_GIF_WARNING] : [];
  }

  private async renderFrame(buffer: Buffer, dimension: number): Promise<RenderedFrame> {
    const { data, info } = await sharp(buffer, { failOn: "error" })
      .rotate()
      .resize({
        width: dimension,
        height: dimension,
        fit: "contain",
        position: "centre",
        background: TRANSPARENT,
      })
      .ensureAlpha()
      .raw()
      .toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });

    return { data, width: info.width, height: info.height };
  }

  private rebuild(frame: RenderedFrame): sharp.Sharp {
    return sharp(frame.data, {
      raw: { width: frame.width, height: frame.height, channels: 4 },
    });
  }

  private async encodeSticker(frame: RenderedFrame): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    let best: Buffer | null = null;

    for (const quality of STICKER_QUALITY_STEPS) {
      const encoded = await this.rebuild(frame)
        .webp({
          quality,
          alphaQuality: Math.max(quality, 50),
          effort: 6,
          smartSubsample: true,
        })
        .toBuffer();

      best = encoded;
      if (encoded.length <= STICKER_MAX_BYTES) break;
    }

    if (!best) throw new AppError("CONVERSION_FAILED", "Ã‡Ä±kartma oluÅŸturulamadÄ±.", 500);

    const warnings: string[] = [];
    if (best.length > STICKER_MAX_BYTES) {
      warnings.push("Bu Ã§Ä±kartma 100 KB'den bÃ¼yÃ¼k, WhatsApp reddedebilir.");
    }

    return {
      buffer: best,
      mimeType: "image/webp",
      extension: "webp",
      width: frame.width,
      height: frame.height,
      sizeBytes: best.length,
      warnings,
    };
  }

  private async encodePng(frame: RenderedFrame): Promise<ConversionResult> {
    const encoded = await this.rebuild(frame)
      .png({ compressionLevel: 9, adaptiveFiltering: true })
      .toBuffer();

    return {
      buffer: encoded,
      mimeType: "image/png",
      extension: "png",
      width: frame.width,
      height: frame.height,
      sizeBytes: encoded.length,
      warnings: [],
    };
  }
}


===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\lib\services\media\ffmpeg.ts =====

import { spawn } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";

export interface FfmpegRun {
  readonly exitCode: number | null;
  readonly stderr: string;
  readonly timedOut: boolean;
}

const MAX_STDERR_CHARS = 64 * 1024;

const BUNDLED_BINARY = process.platform === "win32" ? "ffmpeg.exe" : "ffmpeg";

const MAX_PARENT_LEVELS = 6;

let bundledPath: string | null | undefined;

function loadBundledPath(): string | null {
  if (bundledPath !== undefined) {
    return bundledPath;
  }

  let directory = process.cwd();
  for (let level = 0; level < MAX_PARENT_LEVELS; level += 1) {
    const candidate = join(directory, "node_modules", "ffmpeg-static", BUNDLED_BINARY);
    if (existsSync(candidate)) {
      bundledPath = candidate;
      return candidate;
    }
    const parent = dirname(directory);
    if (parent === directory) {
      break;
    }
    directory = parent;
  }

  bundledPath = null;
  return null;
}

export function getFfmpegPath(): string | null {
  const fromEnv = process.env.FFMPEG_PATH;
  if (fromEnv && existsSync(fromEnv)) {
    return fromEnv;
  }
  return loadBundledPath();
}

export function runFfmpeg(
  binary: string,
  args: readonly string[],
  timeoutMs: number,
): Promise<FfmpegRun> {
  return new Promise<FfmpegRun>((resolve, reject) => {
    const child = spawn(binary, [...args], { stdio: ["ignore", "ignore", "pipe"] });
    let stderr = "";
    let timedOut = false;

    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      timedOut = true;
      child.kill("SIGKILL");
    }, Math.max(1, timeoutMs));

    child.stderr.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
      if (stderr.length < MAX_STDERR_CHARS) {
        stderr += chunk.toString("utf8");
      }
    });

    child.on("error", (error) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      reject(error);
    });

    child.on("close", (exitCode) => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve({ exitCode, stderr, timedOut });
    });
  });
}

export interface ProbeResult {
  readonly hasVideo: boolean;
  readonly durationSeconds: number | null;
}

export function parseProbeOutput(stderr: string): ProbeResult {
  const hasVideo = /Stream #\d+:\d+.*Video:/.test(stderr);
  const match = /Duration:\s*(\d+):(\d+):(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/.exec(stderr);
  const hours = match?.[1];
  const minutes = match?.[2];
  const seconds = match?.[3];
  const durationSeconds =
    hours !== undefined && minutes !== undefined && seconds !== undefined
      ? Number(hours) * 3600 + Number(minutes) * 60 + Number(seconds)
      : null;
  return { hasVideo, durationSeconds };
}

export async function probeMedia(binary: string, inputPath: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<ProbeResult> {
  const run = await runFfmpeg(binary, ["-hide_banner", "-i", inputPath], timeoutMs);
  return parseProbeOutput(run.stderr);
}

import {
  JSON_CONTENT_TYPES,
  JSON_RESPONSE_MAX_BYTES,
  SYNDICATION_ENDPOINT,
  X_STATUS_HOSTS,
} from "@/lib/constants";

export type TweetMediaKind = "photo" | "video" | "gif";

export interface TweetMedia {
  readonly kind: TweetMediaKind;
  readonly imageUrl: string | null;
  readonly videoUrls: readonly string[];
}

export interface TweetReference {
  readonly tweetId: string;
  readonly mediaIndex: number;
}

type UnknownRecord = Record<string, unknown>;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is UnknownRecord {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function asString(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.length > 0 ? value : null;
}

function asArray(value: unknown): readonly unknown[] {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value : [];
}

export function getSyndicationToken(tweetId: string): string {
  return ((Number(tweetId) / 1e15) * Math.PI).toString(36).replace(/(0+|\.)/g, "");
}

export function parseTweetReference(url: URL): TweetReference | null {
  const statusMatch = /\/status(?:es)?\/(\d{1,25})(?:[/?#]|$)/.exec(url.pathname);
  const tweetId = statusMatch?.[1];
  if (!tweetId) {
    return null;
  }
  const mediaMatch = /\/(?:photo|video)\/(\d{1,2})(?:[/?#]|$)/.exec(url.pathname);
  const requested = mediaMatch?.[1] ? Number.parseInt(mediaMatch[1], 10) : 1;
  return { tweetId, mediaIndex: Math.max(0, requested - 1) };
}

function extractVideoUrls(videoInfo: unknown): string[] {
  if (!isRecord(videoInfo)) {
    return [];
  }

  const variants: { url: string; bitrate: number }[] = [];
  for (const entry of asArray(videoInfo.variants)) {
    if (!isRecord(entry) || entry.content_type !== "video/mp4") {
      continue;
    }
    const variantUrl = asString(entry.url);
    if (variantUrl) {
      const bitrate = typeof entry.bitrate === "number" ? entry.bitrate : 0;
      variants.push({ url: variantUrl, bitrate });
    }
  }

  return variants.sort((a, b) => b.bitrate - a.bitrate).map((variant) => variant.url);
}

export function extractTweetMedia(data: unknown): TweetMedia[] {
  if (!isRecord(data)) {
    return [];
  }

  const result: TweetMedia[] = [];

  for (const entry of asArray(data.mediaDetails)) {
    if (!isRecord(entry)) {
      continue;
    }
    const imageUrl = asString(entry.media_url_https);

    if (entry.type === "photo" && imageUrl) {
      result.push({ kind: "photo", imageUrl, videoUrls: [] });
    } else if (entry.type === "video" || entry.type === "animated_gif") {
      const videoUrls = extractVideoUrls(entry.video_info);
      if (videoUrls.length > 0) {
        result.push({
          kind: entry.type === "video" ? "video" : "gif",
          imageUrl,
          videoUrls,
        });
      }
    }
  }

  if (result.length > 0) {
    return result;
  }

  for (const entry of asArray(data.photos)) {
    const photoUrl = isRecord(entry) ? asString(entry.url) : null;
    if (photoUrl) {
      result.push({ kind: "photo", imageUrl: photoUrl, videoUrls: [] });
    }
  }

  if (isRecord(data.video)) {
    const videoUrls = asArray(data.video.variants)
      .filter((entry): entry is UnknownRecord => isRecord(entry) && entry.type === "video/mp4")
      .map((entry) => asString(entry.src))
      .filter((src): src is string => src !== null);
    if (videoUrls.length > 0) {
      result.push({ kind: "video", imageUrl: asString(data.video.poster), videoUrls });
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function toCandidateUrls(media: TweetMedia): URL[] {
  const rawUrls: string[] = [];

  if (media.kind === "photo" && media.imageUrl) {
    try {
      const large = new URL(media.imageUrl);
      large.searchParams.set("name", "large");
      rawUrls.push(large.href);
    } catch {
      // GeÃ§ersiz adres; aÅŸaÄŸÄ±daki doÄŸrulama bunu eler.
    }
    rawUrls.push(media.imageUrl);
  } else {
    rawUrls.push(...media.videoUrls);
  }

  const candidates: URL[] = [];
  for (const raw of rawUrls) {
    const validation = parseImportUrl(raw);
    if (validation.ok) {
      candidates.push(validation.url);
    }
  }
  return candidates;
}

async function fetchTweetJson(tweetId: string, context: ResolveContext): Promise<unknown> {
  const endpoint = new URL(SYNDICATION_ENDPOINT);
  endpoint.searchParams.set("id", tweetId);
  endpoint.searchParams.set("lang", "en");
  endpoint.searchParams.set("token", getSyndicationToken(tweetId));

  let body: Buffer;
  try {
    const fetched = await safeFetch(endpoint, {
      timeoutMs: context.remainingMs(),
      maxBytes: JSON_RESPONSE_MAX_BYTES,
      accept: "application/json",
      allowedContentTypes: JSON_CONTENT_TYPES,
    });
    body = fetched.buffer;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof AppError && error.code === "MEDIA_NOT_ACCESSIBLE") {
      throw new AppError(
        "MEDIA_NOT_ACCESSIBLE",
        "Bu X gÃ¶nderisine ulaÅŸÄ±lamadÄ±. GÃ¶nderi silinmiÅŸ, gizli ya da hassas iÃ§erik nedeniyle kÄ±sÄ±tlÄ± olabilir.",
      );
    }
    if (error instanceof AppError && error.code === "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA") {
      throw new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "X'ten beklenmeyen bir yanÄ±t alÄ±ndÄ±. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.");
    }
    throw error;
  }

  try {
    return JSON.parse(body.toString("utf8")) as unknown;
  } catch {
    throw new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "X'ten gelen yanÄ±t okunamadÄ±. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.");
  }
}

  matches(url: URL): boolean {

      );

      throw new AppError(
        "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
        "Bu gÃ¶nderide gÃ¶rsel, GIF veya video bulunamadÄ±.",

    const selected = media[reference.mediaIndex];
    if (!selected) {
      throw new AppError(
        "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
        `Bu gÃ¶nderide ${reference.mediaIndex + 1}. medya yok. GÃ¶nderide ${media.length} medya var.`,

    const suffix = media.length > 1 ? `-${reference.mediaIndex + 1}` : "";
    return { candidates, filenameHint: `x-${reference.tweetId}${suffix}` };
  },

import dns from "node:dns";
import http from "node:http";
import https from "node:https";
import net from "node:net";
import {
  IMPORT_DECLARED_CONTENT_TYPES,
  MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES,
  MAX_FILE_SIZE_LABEL,
  URL_IMPORT_MAX_REDIRECTS,
  URL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT_MS,
  URL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
} from "@/lib/constants";
import { AppError } from "@/lib/utils/errors";
import { isBlockedAddress } from "@/lib/utils/ip-guard";

  BLOCKED_HOST_MESSAGE,

  stripIpv6Brackets,

export interface SafeFetchOptions {
  readonly timeoutMs?: number;
  readonly maxBytes?: number;
  readonly maxRedirects?: number;
  readonly accept?: string;
  readonly allowedContentTypes?: readonly string[];
}

export interface FetchedMedia {
  readonly buffer: Buffer;
  readonly contentType: string | null;
  readonly finalUrl: URL;
}

interface RequestPolicy {
  readonly headers: http.OutgoingHttpHeaders;
  readonly allowedContentTypes: readonly string[];
  readonly maxBytes: number;
}

interface BodyOutcome {
  readonly kind: "body";
  readonly buffer: Buffer;
  readonly contentType: string | null;
}

interface RedirectOutcome {
  readonly kind: "redirect";
  readonly location: string;
}

type HopOutcome = BodyOutcome | RedirectOutcome;

const BLOCKED_ERROR_CODE = "EBLOCKED";

const DEFAULT_ACCEPT = "image/*,video/mp4,video/webm;q=0.9,*/*;q=0.5";

function createBlockedError(): NodeJS.ErrnoException {
  const error: NodeJS.ErrnoException = new Error("Blocked address");
  error.code = BLOCKED_ERROR_CODE;
  return error;
}

const safeLookup: net.LookupFunction = (hostname, options, callback) => {
  dns.promises
    .lookup(hostname, {
      all: true,
      verbatim: true,
      family: options.family,
      hints: options.hints,
    })
    .then((addresses) => {
      const first = addresses[0];
      if (!first || addresses.some((entry) => isBlockedAddress(entry.address))) {
        callback(createBlockedError(), "", 0);
        return;
      }
      if (options.all) {
        callback(null, addresses);
        return;
      }
      callback(null, first.address, first.family);
    })
    .catch((error: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => {
      callback(error, "", 0);
    });
};

function tooLargeError(): AppError {
  return new AppError(
    "FILE_TOO_LARGE",
    `Medya Ã§ok bÃ¼yÃ¼k. Ä°zin verilen en bÃ¼yÃ¼k boyut ${MAX_FILE_SIZE_LABEL}.`,
  );
}

function statusToError(status: number): AppError {
  if (status >= 500) {
    return new AppError(
      "REMOTE_ERROR",
      `Uzak sunucu bir hata verdi (HTTP ${status}). Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.`,
    );
  }
  if (status === 429) {
    return new AppError(
      "REMOTE_ERROR",
      "Uzak sunucu Ã§ok fazla istek aldÄ±ÄŸÄ±nÄ± bildirdi (HTTP 429). Biraz bekleyip tekrar deneyin.",
    );
  }
  return new AppError(
    "MEDIA_NOT_ACCESSIBLE",
    `Medyaya eriÅŸilemedi (HTTP ${status}). BaÄŸlantÄ±nÄ±n herkese aÃ§Ä±k olduÄŸundan emin olun.`,
  );
}

function headerValue(value: string | string[] | undefined): string | null {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value[0] ?? null;
  }
  return value ?? null;
}

function normalizeContentType(contentType: string): string {
  return contentType.split(";")[0]?.trim().toLowerCase() ?? "";
}

function contentTypeError(contentType: string): AppError {
  const mime = normalizeContentType(contentType);
  if (mime === "text/html" || mime === "application/xhtml+xml") {
    return new AppError(
      "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
      "Bu baÄŸlantÄ± bir web sayfasÄ±na Ã§Ä±kÄ±yor, doÄŸrudan bir medya dosyasÄ±na deÄŸil. DoÄŸrudan gÃ¶rsel, GIF veya video baÄŸlantÄ±sÄ± ya da bir X (Twitter) gÃ¶nderi baÄŸlantÄ±sÄ± kullanÄ±n.",
    );
  }
  return new AppError(
    "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
    "Bu baÄŸlantÄ±daki dosya tÃ¼rÃ¼ desteklenmiyor. JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, MP4 veya WEBM kullanÄ±n.",
  );
}

function assertLiteralAddressAllowed(url: URL): void {
  const host = stripIpv6Brackets(url.hostname);
  if (net.isIP(host) !== 0 && isBlockedAddress(host)) {
    throw new AppError("BLOCKED_HOST", BLOCKED_HOST_MESSAGE);
  }
}

function resolveRedirect(location: string, base: URL): URL {
  let next: URL;
  try {
    next = new URL(location, base);
  } catch {
    throw new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "BaÄŸlantÄ±nÄ±n yÃ¶nlendirme adresi geÃ§ersiz.");
  }

  const validation = parseImportUrl(next.href);
  if (!validation.ok) {
    throw new AppError(validation.code, validation.message);
  }
  return validation.url;
}

function requestOnce(url: URL, signal: AbortSignal, policy: RequestPolicy): Promise<HopOutcome> {
  return new Promise<HopOutcome>((resolve, reject) => {
    const transport = url.protocol === "https:" ? https : http;

    const request = transport.request(
      url,
      { method: "GET", headers: policy.headers, lookup: safeLookup, signal },
      (response) => {
        const status = response.statusCode ?? 0;
        const location = headerValue(response.headers.location);

        if (status >= 300 && status < 400 && location) {
          response.resume();
          resolve({ kind: "redirect", location });
          return;
        }

        if (status < 200 || status >= 300) {
          response.resume();
          reject(statusToError(status));
          return;
        }

        const contentType = headerValue(response.headers["content-type"]);
        if (
          contentType &&
          !policy.allowedContentTypes.includes(normalizeContentType(contentType))
        ) {
          response.destroy();
          reject(contentTypeError(contentType));
          return;
        }

        const declaredLength = Number(headerValue(response.headers["content-length"]));
        if (Number.isFinite(declaredLength) && declaredLength > policy.maxBytes) {
          response.destroy();
          reject(tooLargeError());
          return;
        }

        const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
        let received = 0;

        response.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => {
          received += chunk.length;
          if (received > policy.maxBytes) {
            response.destroy();
            reject(tooLargeError());
            return;
          }
          chunks.push(chunk);
        });

        response.on("end", () => {
          resolve({ kind: "body", buffer: Buffer.concat(chunks, received), contentType });
        });

        response.on("error", reject);

        response.on("close", () => {
          if (!response.complete) {
            reject(new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "BaÄŸlantÄ± indirme sÄ±rasÄ±nda kesildi. Tekrar deneyin."));
          }
        });
      },
    );

    request.on("error", reject);
    request.end();
  });
}

function translateFetchError(error: unknown, timedOut: boolean): AppError {
  if (timedOut) {
    return new AppError(
      "FETCH_TIMEOUT",
      `Uzak sunucu ${URL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS} saniye iÃ§inde yanÄ±t vermedi. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.`,
    );
  }

  if (error instanceof AppError) {
    return error;
  }

  const code = (error as NodeJS.ErrnoException | null)?.code;

  if (code === BLOCKED_ERROR_CODE) {
    return new AppError("BLOCKED_HOST", BLOCKED_HOST_MESSAGE);
  }
  if (code === "ENOTFOUND" || code === "EAI_AGAIN") {
    return new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "Bu adres bulunamadÄ±. BaÄŸlantÄ±yÄ± kontrol edin.");
  }
  if (code === "ETIMEDOUT" || code === "ESOCKETTIMEDOUT") {
    return new AppError(
      "FETCH_TIMEOUT",
      "Uzak sunucuya baÄŸlanÄ±rken zaman aÅŸÄ±mÄ± oluÅŸtu. Daha sonra tekrar deneyin.",
    );
  }

  return new AppError(
    "FETCH_FAILED",
    "Uzak sunucuya baÄŸlanÄ±lamadÄ±. Adresi kontrol edip tekrar deneyin.",
  );
}

export async function safeFetch(
  startUrl: URL,
  options: SafeFetchOptions = {},
): Promise<FetchedMedia> {
  const timeoutMs = options.timeoutMs ?? URL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT_MS;
  const maxRedirects = options.maxRedirects ?? URL_IMPORT_MAX_REDIRECTS;

  const policy: RequestPolicy = {
    maxBytes: options.maxBytes ?? MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES,
    allowedContentTypes: options.allowedContentTypes ?? IMPORT_DECLARED_CONTENT_TYPES,
    headers: {
      "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; WhatsAppStickerConverter/1.0)",
      Accept: options.accept ?? DEFAULT_ACCEPT,
      "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
    },
  };

  const controller = new AbortController();
  let timedOut = false;
  const timer = setTimeout(() => {
    timedOut = true;
    controller.abort();
  }, Math.max(0, timeoutMs));

  try {
    let current = startUrl;

    for (let hop = 0; hop <= maxRedirects; hop += 1) {
      assertLiteralAddressAllowed(current);

      const outcome = await requestOnce(current, controller.signal, policy);

      if (outcome.kind === "body") {
        return { buffer: outcome.buffer, contentType: outcome.contentType, finalUrl: current };
      }

      current = resolveRedirect(outcome.location, current);
    }

    throw new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "BaÄŸlantÄ± Ã§ok fazla yÃ¶nlendirme iÃ§eriyor.");
  } catch (error) {
    throw translateFetchError(error, timedOut);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}

import { URL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT_MS } from "@/lib/constants";
import { getBaseName } from "@/lib/utils/format";

export interface ImportedMedia {
  readonly buffer: Buffer;
  readonly mimeType: MediaMimeType;
  readonly kind: MediaKind;
  readonly extension: string;
  readonly filename: string;
  readonly sizeBytes: number;
}

function decodeSegment(segment: string): string {
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(segment);
  } catch {
    return segment;
  }
}

function filenameFromUrl(url: URL): string {
  const lastSegment = url.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).pop() ?? "";
  return decodeSegment(lastSegment);
}

async function downloadFirstAvailable(
  candidates: readonly URL[],
  context: ResolveContext,
): Promise<FetchedMedia> {
  let lastError: unknown = null;

  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    try {
      return await safeFetch(candidate, { timeoutMs: context.remainingMs() });
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error;
      const canTryNext = error instanceof AppError && error.code === "FILE_TOO_LARGE";
      if (!canTryNext) {
        throw error;
      }
    }
  }

  throw lastError instanceof Error
    ? lastError
    : new AppError("FETCH_FAILED", "Medya indirilemedi. Tekrar deneyin.");
}

export async function importMediaFromUrl(rawUrl: string): Promise<ImportedMedia> {
  const parsed = parseImportUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!parsed.ok) {
    throw new AppError(parsed.code, parsed.message);
  }

  const deadline = Date.now() + URL_IMPORT_TIMEOUT_MS;
  const context: ResolveContext = {
    remainingMs: () => Math.max(0, deadline - Date.now()),
  };

  const resolver = findResolver(parsed.url);
  const resolved = resolver ? await resolver.resolve(parsed.url, context) : null;
  const candidates = resolved ? resolved.candidates : [parsed.url];

  const fetched = await downloadFirstAvailable(candidates, context);

  const mimeType = detectMediaType(fetched.buffer);
  if (!mimeType) {
    throw new AppError(
      "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA",
      "Bu baÄŸlantÄ±daki dosya tÃ¼rÃ¼ desteklenmiyor. JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, MP4 veya WEBM kullanÄ±n.",
    );
  }

  const { kind, extension } = getMediaInfo(mimeType);
  const nameSource = resolved ? resolved.filenameHint : filenameFromUrl(fetched.finalUrl);

  return {
    buffer: fetched.buffer,
    mimeType,
    kind,
    extension,
    filename: `${getBaseName(nameSource)}.${extension}`,
    sizeBytes: fetched.buffer.length,
  };
}

import type { ApiErrorBody } from "@/types/api";

export class ApiClientError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiClientError";
  }
}

export const NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE =
  "Sunucuya ulaÅŸÄ±lamadÄ±. BaÄŸlantÄ±nÄ±zÄ± kontrol edip tekrar deneyin.";

function isApiErrorBody(value: unknown): value is ApiErrorBody {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null || !("error" in value)) {
    return false;
  }
  const inner = (value as { error: unknown }).error;
  return (
    typeof inner === "object" &&
    inner !== null &&
    "message" in inner &&
    typeof (inner as { message: unknown }).message === "string"
  );
}

export async function readApiErrorMessage(response: Response, fallback: string): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const body: unknown = await response.json();
    if (isApiErrorBody(body)) {
      return body.error.message;
    }
  } catch {
    // GÃ¶vde JSON deÄŸil; aÅŸaÄŸÄ±daki genel mesaja dÃ¼ÅŸÃ¼lÃ¼r.
  }

  if (response.status === 413) {
    return "Dosya sunucu iÃ§in Ã§ok bÃ¼yÃ¼k. Daha kÃ¼Ã§Ã¼k bir dosya deneyin.";
  }
  return fallback;
}

import { CONVERT_ENDPOINT, META_HEADER, OUTPUT_OPTIONS } from "@/lib/constants";
import type { ConversionMeta, ConversionOutput } from "@/types/api";
import type { OutputOption, OutputType } from "@/types/media";
import { ApiClientError, NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE, readApiErrorMessage } from "./api-client-utils";

function parseMeta(header: string | null, fallbackSize: number, dimension: number): ConversionMeta {
  const fallback: ConversionMeta = {
    width: dimension,
    height: dimension,
    sizeBytes: fallbackSize,
    warnings: [],
  };

  if (!header) {
    return fallback;
  }

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(header);
    if (
      typeof parsed === "object" &&
      parsed !== null &&
      "width" in parsed &&
      "height" in parsed &&
      "sizeBytes" in parsed &&
      "warnings" in parsed
    ) {
      const candidate = parsed as {
        width: unknown;
        height: unknown;
        sizeBytes: unknown;
        warnings: unknown;
      };
      if (
        typeof candidate.width === "number" &&
        typeof candidate.height === "number" &&
        typeof candidate.sizeBytes === "number" &&
        Array.isArray(candidate.warnings)
      ) {
        return {
          width: candidate.width,
          height: candidate.height,
          sizeBytes: candidate.sizeBytes,
          warnings: candidate.warnings
            .filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
            .map((item) => decodeURIComponent(item)),
        };
      }
    }
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }

  return fallback;
}

export function getOutputOption(outputType: OutputType): OutputOption {
  const option = OUTPUT_OPTIONS.find((item) => item.type === outputType);
  if (!option) {
    throw new ApiClientError("Bilinmeyen Ã§Ä±ktÄ± tÃ¼rÃ¼.");
  }
  return option;
}

export async function convertMedia(
  file: File,
  dimension: number,
  outputType: OutputType,
): Promise<ConversionOutput> {
  const body = new FormData();
  body.append("file", file);
  body.append("size", String(dimension));
  body.append("output", outputType);

  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(CONVERT_ENDPOINT, { method: "POST", body });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiClientError(NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE);
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new ApiClientError(
      await readApiErrorMessage(response, "DÃ¶nÃ¼ÅŸtÃ¼rme baÅŸarÄ±sÄ±z oldu. LÃ¼tfen tekrar deneyin."),
    );
  }

  const blob = await response.blob();
  const meta = parseMeta(response.headers.get(META_HEADER), blob.size, dimension);
  const option = getOutputOption(outputType);

  return {
    ...meta,
    blob,
    mimeType: option.mimeType,
    extension: option.extension,
    outputType,
  };
}

import { IMPORT_ENDPOINT, IMPORT_META_HEADER } from "@/lib/constants";
import { isMediaMimeType } from "@/lib/utils/media";
import type { ImportedMediaMeta } from "@/types/api";
import type { MediaKind } from "@/types/media";
import { ApiClientError, NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE, readApiErrorMessage } from "./api-client-utils";

const UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE_MESSAGE = "Sunucudan beklenmeyen bir yanÄ±t alÄ±ndÄ±. LÃ¼tfen tekrar deneyin.";

function isMediaKind(value: unknown): value is MediaKind {
  return value === "image" || value === "gif" || value === "video";
}

function parseImportMeta(header: string | null): ImportedMediaMeta {
  if (!header) {
    throw new ApiClientError(UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE_MESSAGE);
  }

  let parsed: unknown;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(header);
  } catch {
    throw new ApiClientError(UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE_MESSAGE);
  }

  if (typeof parsed === "object" && parsed !== null) {
    const candidate = parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    const { mimeType, kind, sizeBytes, filename } = candidate;
    if (
      typeof mimeType === "string" &&
      isMediaMimeType(mimeType) &&
      isMediaKind(kind) &&
      typeof sizeBytes === "number" &&
      typeof filename === "string"
    ) {
      return { mimeType, kind, sizeBytes, filename };
    }
  }

  throw new ApiClientError(UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE_MESSAGE);
}

export async function fetchMediaFromUrl(url: string): Promise<File> {
  let response: Response;
  try {
    response = await fetch(IMPORT_ENDPOINT, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ url }),
    });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiClientError(NETWORK_ERROR_MESSAGE);
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new ApiClientError(
      await readApiErrorMessage(response, "Medya iÃ§e aktarÄ±lamadÄ±. LÃ¼tfen tekrar deneyin."),
    );
  }

  const meta = parseImportMeta(response.headers.get(IMPORT_META_HEADER));
  const blob = await response.blob();

  return new File([blob], meta.filename, { type: meta.mimeType });
}

===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\lib\utils\format.ts =====

export function formatBytes(bytes: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(bytes) || bytes < 0) {
    return "0 B";
  }
  if (bytes < 1024) {
    return `${bytes} B`;
  }
  const kilobytes = bytes / 1024;
  if (kilobytes < 1024) {
    const digits = kilobytes < 10 ? 2 : 1;
    return `${kilobytes.toLocaleString("tr-TR", {
      minimumFractionDigits: digits,
      maximumFractionDigits: digits,
    })} KB`;
  }
  return `${(kilobytes / 1024).toLocaleString("tr-TR", {
    minimumFractionDigits: 2,
    maximumFractionDigits: 2,
  })} MB`;
}

export function getBaseName(filename: string): string {
  const withoutExtension = filename.replace(/\.[^./\\]+$/, "");
  const cleaned = withoutExtension
    .replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9-_ ]+/g, "")
    .trim()
    .replace(/\s+/g, "-");
  return cleaned.length > 0 ? cleaned.slice(0, 60) : "gorsel";
}

export function getFileTypeLabel(filename: string): string {
  const match = /\.([a-zA-Z0-9]+)$/.exec(filename);
  return match?.[1] ? match[1].toUpperCase() : "Bilinmiyor";
}

export function buildOutputFilename(
  originalName: string,
  outputType: "sticker" | "image" | "animation",
  dimension: number,
  extension: string,
): string {
  const base = getBaseName(originalName);
  const suffix =
    outputType === "sticker"
      ? "cikartma"
      : outputType === "animation"
        ? "animasyon"
        : "gorsel";
  return `${base}-${suffix}-${dimension}.${extension}`;
}

import { BlockList, isIP } from "node:net";

type RangeEntry = readonly [string, number];

const IPV4_BLOCKED_RANGES: readonly RangeEntry[] = [
  ["0.0.0.0", 8],
  ["10.0.0.0", 8],
  ["100.64.0.0", 10],
  ["127.0.0.0", 8],
  ["169.254.0.0", 16],
  ["172.16.0.0", 12],
  ["192.0.0.0", 24],
  ["192.0.2.0", 24],
  ["192.88.99.0", 24],
  ["192.168.0.0", 16],
  ["198.18.0.0", 15],
  ["198.51.100.0", 24],
  ["203.0.113.0", 24],
  ["224.0.0.0", 4],
  ["240.0.0.0", 4],
];

const IPV6_BLOCKED_RANGES: readonly RangeEntry[] = [
  ["::", 96],
  ["64:ff9b::", 96],
  ["100::", 64],
  ["2001::", 32],
  ["2001:db8::", 32],
  ["2002::", 16],
  ["fc00::", 7],
  ["fe80::", 10],
  ["ff00::", 8],
];

const blockList = new BlockList();

for (const [network, prefix] of IPV4_BLOCKED_RANGES) {
  blockList.addSubnet(network, prefix, "ipv4");
}
for (const [network, prefix] of IPV6_BLOCKED_RANGES) {
  blockList.addSubnet(network, prefix, "ipv6");
}

export function isBlockedAddress(address: string): boolean {
  const family = isIP(address);
  if (family === 4) {
    return blockList.check(address, "ipv4");
  }
  if (family === 6) {
    return blockList.check(address, "ipv6");
  }
  return true;
}



===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\lib\utils\media.ts =====

import type { MediaKind, MediaMimeType } from "@/types/media";

interface MediaInfo {
  readonly kind: MediaKind;
  readonly extension: string;
}

const MEDIA_INFO: Readonly<Record<MediaMimeType, MediaInfo>> = {
  "image/jpeg": { kind: "image", extension: "jpg" },
  "image/png": { kind: "image", extension: "png" },
  "image/webp": { kind: "image", extension: "webp" },
  "image/gif": { kind: "gif", extension: "gif" },
  "video/mp4": { kind: "video", extension: "mp4" },
  "video/webm": { kind: "video", extension: "webm" },
};

const EXTENSION_KIND: Readonly<Record<string, MediaKind>> = {
  ".gif": "gif",
  ".mp4": "video",
  ".webm": "video",
};

export function isMediaMimeType(value: string): value is MediaMimeType {
  return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(MEDIA_INFO, value);
}

export function getMediaInfo(mimeType: MediaMimeType): MediaInfo {
  return MEDIA_INFO[mimeType];
}

export function getMediaKindFromFile(file: { readonly name: string; readonly type: string }): MediaKind {
  const mime = file.type.toLowerCase();
  if (isMediaMimeType(mime)) {
    return MEDIA_INFO[mime].kind;
  }
  const dotIndex = file.name.lastIndexOf(".");
  const extension = dotIndex === -1 ? "" : file.name.slice(dotIndex).toLowerCase();
  return EXTENSION_KIND[extension] ?? "image";
}



===== C:\Users\Ali Kaan\Desktop\2027 Projeleri\whatsapp-sticker-converter\lib\utils\sniff.ts =====

import type { MediaMimeType } from "@/types/media";

const PNG_SIGNATURE = Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]);
const EBML_SIGNATURE = Buffer.from([0x1a, 0x45, 0xdf, 0xa3]);

export function detectMediaType(buffer: Buffer): MediaMimeType | null {
  if (buffer.length >= 3 && buffer[0] === 0xff && buffer[1] === 0xd8 && buffer[2] === 0xff) {
    return "image/jpeg";
  }

  if (buffer.length >= 8 && buffer.subarray(0, 8).equals(PNG_SIGNATURE)) {
    return "image/png";
  }

  if (
    buffer.length >= 12 &&
    buffer.subarray(0, 4).toString("ascii") === "RIFF" &&
    buffer.subarray(8, 12).toString("ascii") === "WEBP"
  ) {
    return "image/webp";
  }

  if (buffer.length >= 6) {
    const header = buffer.subarray(0, 6).toString("ascii");
    if (header === "GIF87a" || header === "GIF89a") {
      return "image/gif";
    }
  }

  if (buffer.length >= 12 && buffer.subarray(4, 8).toString("ascii") === "ftyp") {
    const brand = buffer.subarray(8, 12).toString("ascii");
    if (brand !== "qt  ") {
      return "video/mp4";
    }
  }

  if (
    buffer.length >= 4 &&
    buffer.subarray(0, 4).equals(EBML_SIGNATURE) &&
    buffer.subarray(0, Math.min(buffer.length, 64)).includes("webm")
  ) {
    return "video/webm";
  }

  return null;
}

import { URL_MAX_LENGTH } from "@/lib/constants";
import type { ApiErrorCode } from "@/types/api";

export type UrlValidationResult =
  | { readonly ok: true; readonly url: URL }
  | { readonly ok: false; readonly code: ApiErrorCode; readonly message: string };

const BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES: readonly string[] = [
  ".localhost",
  ".local",
  ".internal",
  ".localdomain",
  ".home.arpa",
  ".lan",
  ".intranet",
];

export const BLOCKED_HOST_MESSAGE =
  "Bu adrese eriÅŸime izin verilmiyor. Herkese aÃ§Ä±k bir baÄŸlantÄ± kullanÄ±n.";

export function stripIpv6Brackets(hostname: string): string {
  return hostname.startsWith("[") && hostname.endsWith("]") ? hostname.slice(1, -1) : hostname;
}

export function isBlockedHostname(hostname: string): boolean {
  const host = stripIpv6Brackets(hostname).toLowerCase().replace(/\.$/, "");

  if (host === "" || host === "localhost") {
    return true;
  }
  if (BLOCKED_HOST_SUFFIXES.some((suffix) => host.endsWith(suffix))) {
    return true;
  }

  const isIpv6Literal = host.includes(":");
  if (!isIpv6Literal && !host.includes(".")) {
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

export function parseImportUrl(raw: string): UrlValidationResult {
  const trimmed = raw.trim();

  if (trimmed === "") {
    return { ok: false, code: "INVALID_URL", message: "LÃ¼tfen bir baÄŸlantÄ± yapÄ±ÅŸtÄ±rÄ±n." };
  }

  if (trimmed.length > URL_MAX_LENGTH) {
    return { ok: false, code: "INVALID_URL", message: "BaÄŸlantÄ± Ã§ok uzun." };
  }

  let url: URL;
  try {
    url = new URL(trimmed);
  } catch {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INVALID_URL",
      message: "GeÃ§ersiz baÄŸlantÄ±. https:// ile baÅŸlayan tam bir adres girin.",
    };
  }

  if (url.protocol !== "http:" && url.protocol !== "https:") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INVALID_URL",
      message: "YalnÄ±zca http:// ve https:// baÄŸlantÄ±larÄ± desteklenir.",
    };
  }

  if (url.username !== "" || url.password !== "") {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: "INVALID_URL",
      message: "KullanÄ±cÄ± adÄ± veya ÅŸifre iÃ§eren baÄŸlantÄ±lar desteklenmez.",
    };
  }

  if (isBlockedHostname(url.hostname)) {
    return { ok: false, code: "BLOCKED_HOST", message: BLOCKED_HOST_MESSAGE };
  }

  return { ok: true, url };
}

import type { MediaKind, MediaMimeType, OutputType } from "./media";

export type ApiErrorCode =
  | "MISSING_FILE"
  | "EMPTY_FILE"
  | "INVALID_FORMAT"
  | "FILE_TOO_LARGE"
  | "INVALID_OPTIONS"
  | "CORRUPT_IMAGE"
  | "UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA"
  | "CONVERSION_FAILED"
  | "SERVER_ERROR"
  | "INVALID_URL"
  | "BLOCKED_HOST"
  | "MEDIA_NOT_ACCESSIBLE"
  | "FETCH_FAILED"
  | "FETCH_TIMEOUT"
  | "REMOTE_ERROR";

export interface ApiErrorBody {
  readonly error: {
    readonly code: ApiErrorCode;
    readonly message: string;
  };
}

export interface ConversionMeta {
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
  readonly sizeBytes: number;
  readonly warnings: readonly string[];
}

export interface ConversionOutput extends ConversionMeta {
  readonly blob: Blob;
  readonly mimeType: string;
  readonly extension: string;
  readonly outputType: OutputType;
}

export interface ConvertedFile extends ConversionOutput {
  readonly url: string;
  readonly filename: string;
}

export type ConversionStatus = "idle" | "processing" | "success" | "error";

export interface ImportedMediaMeta {
  readonly mimeType: MediaMimeType;
  readonly kind: MediaKind;
  readonly sizeBytes: number;
  readonly filename: string;
}
